scope: Bounded screening of exactly three client-component candidates; no model calls, authentication changes or spending
source_delta_check: No changes in mods/agents-md, mods/diff, mod types, LICENSE.md, SECURITY.md or issue templates between the pin and observed remote HEAD. Native engine remains the recorded 2.1.288; no latest-engine claim.

candidates.title: Real merge/rebase state detection and abort recovery, ordinary and linked worktrees
candidates.criterion: Source component repositoryOf/isTransient must agree with actual rev-parse paths, marker entry kinds and known successful/failed Git operations. Linked worktree state must use its own gitDir rather than commonDir.
candidates.controls: clean / conflict / abort, ordinary / linked worktree; rebase conflict / abort

candidates.title: Raw Git output parsing with supported special filenames and staged rename
candidates.criterion: dirtyPathsOf, parseNumstat and parseFileDiffs must retain exact supported path spellings, text changes and binary flag. A real staged rename must retain old/new identities.
candidates.controls: known written text / binary, spaces / non-ASCII names, changed / clean, staged rename / unchanged content
candidates.exclusions: Windows forbids tab/newline filename characters; they are not silently simulated as real-file tests.

candidates.title: Nested AGENTS.md delivery and duplicate/recovery guards from actual synthetic files
candidates.criterion: The native engine must deliver exact nested instruction bytes once after successful Read, not on failed Read or outside the root; a context recomputation allows fresh delivery. Whole versus partial direct instruction reads retain documented behavior.
candidates.controls: first / repeated Read, failed / successful Read, inside / sibling root, whole / partial instruction read, nested CLAUDE present / absent

reporting_clarifications_after_execution: The failed-Read guard injects a scripted isError result; it is not a captured real filesystem or permission error. Positive contents are actual file bytes. This clarifies scope without changing functional criteria or excluding any execution.

execution.dispatch: One authored test file per component suite, native CLI invocations sequential
execution.world_bridge: Python creates real temporary files and local Git histories, reads outputs/entry kinds, and injects those snapshots into authored TypeScript tests. Native engine hooks or unchanged public source helpers consume them. This is captured-response replay, not production filesystem/process transport or model inference.
execution.safety: Only fresh .private fixture repositories; local neutral Git identity, hooks disabled for fixture commands; user repo, auth and global settings untouched. Upstream source stays private with original license.
execution.failure_handling: Preserve every invalid/failed batch; do not weaken functional assertions or retroactively change criteria. Harness exceptions and transport/timeout failures are distinct from assertion signals. Only an actual functional signal advances to minimal reproduction, repeated controls and independent case review.
execution.escalation: At most these three candidates. If no new E3/E4 production evidence, gate remains closed; no issue or release. A negative component screen does not prove all production paths correct.
